ns2:course.label: Clinical/Laboratory Practice
ns2:course.description: Individual customized clerkship in clinical medicine and surgery for VM-4 professional students. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 9 hours. Prerequisite: Fourth-year standing in the veterinary medicine professional curriculum.
